# TimerRange

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** TimerRange

## What it does

TimerRange dynamically adjusts the game's internal tick speed based on how close you are to an enemy. Unlike the flat Timer module which runs at a constant speed, TimerRange is reactive: it idles at a slightly reduced speed when no enemies are nearby, ramps up to a strong boost when you close in on a target, and pauses entirely if you get very close. This lets you land hits faster during the critical moments of a fight while spending most of your time at a less suspicious speed.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/timerrange). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
